content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Senior Resident & CMO (General Medicine): Postgraduate Medical Degree i.e. (M.D./M.S./DNB/M.Ch./D.M) or equivalent in the concerned specialty recognized by MCI and registered either with Medical Council of India or State Medical Council.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: Senior Residents & CMO (General Medicine): Maximum age limit is 45 years. Age relaxations apply as follows: OBC: 3 years, SC: 5 years, Govt servants: 5 years, Widows/deserted women/women judicially separated: 10 years.

rows.salary_scale_details: Rs. 67,700/- (minimum pay 1st Cell of Level-11) + NPA @ 20%

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for GMCH Chandigarh Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Government Medical College & Hospital, Chandigarh (GMCH Chandigarh) for filling up temporary medical positions.

faq.question: Q2. What are the total vacancies available under this notification?
faq.answer: A total of 74 vacancies are available for Senior Residents and Casualty Medical Officers across multiple medical departments and specialties.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of application for GMCH Chandigarh recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in. Eligible candidates need to report directly to the interview venue along with required documents.

faq.question: Q4. What is the walk-in interview date?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to be held on 05-10-2026. Candidates must ensure they report on time as per the guidelines.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Postgraduate Medical Degree (M.D./M.S./DNB/M.Ch./D.M) or equivalent in the concerned specialty recognized by the MCI.

faq.question: Q6. What is the upper age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 45 years, with permissible age relaxations for reserved categories such as SC, OBC, and others as per rules.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for these positions?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a basic salary of Rs. 67,700/- per month (minimum pay 1st Cell of Level-11) plus Non-Practicing Allowance (NPA) @ 20%.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: Yes, General category candidates are required to pay Rs. 500/-, while SC candidates need to pay Rs. 250/- on the spot at GMCH.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the walk-in venue located?
faq.answer: Candidates need to submit their filled application form and attend interviews at the Establishment Branch-II, Block-D, GMCH-32, Chandigarh.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should be carried to the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry original educational and medical council registration certificates, self-attested photocopies of documents, ID proof, and passport-size photographs.
